DECLARATION OF MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE
IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO SERVE
THREE LIMITED INTERROGATORIES ON NCMEC BEFORE
THE RULE 26(f) CONFERENCE (ECF NO. 15)
I, Marvelle J. Ballentine, declare as follows:
1. I am the Plaintiff in this action. | make this Declaration based upon my personal
knowledge. I am competent to testify to the matters stated herein.
2. My legal name is Marvelle J. Ballentine.
3. Before April 22, 2026, I never used the name “Marvelle J. Ballentine” to create,

register, identify, maintain, access, or operate any account on any product or service owned or

operated by Meta Platforms, Inc. that I used.

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD Document 31 Filed 08/24/26 Page 2 of 3 PagelD# 361

4, I never used “Marvelle J. Ballentine” as a username, profile name, display name,
account name, or other identity by which I identified myself on Facebook, Instagram, Threads,
WhatsApp, Oculus, Meta Quest, or any other Meta product or service that I used.

5. I did not provide “Marvelle J. Ballentine” to Meta Platforms, Inc. as the name
identifying me or any Meta account that | created, maintained, or operated.

6. In connection with my online identity, including my use of Meta products and
services, I used the name “Jay Ballentine,” rather than “Marvelle J. Ballentine.”

7. To the extent “Marvelle J. Ballentine” appeared in the April 9, 2026
correspondence, draft subpoena materials, or other litigation materials that I transmitted to the
National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, I included that name because it is my legal
name and the name under which the underlying federal litigation was pending. | did not include
that name because I had used it to identify or operate any Meta account.

8. The foregoing statements concern my own use of my name, my own operation of
Meta products and services, and my own preparation and transmission of the litigation materials
referenced above. Each of those matters is within my personal knowledge.

I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.

~rpD

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Executed on August 24, 2026.
